title: Model 100 LIFE Backwards
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

10 REM life backwards april 27, 1985
90 DEFINT A-Z
100 DX=20:DY=20
110 DIM T6(4,4)
280 PRINT"Setting up"
290 DIM CN(380,1)
300 FOR I = 0 TO 511:IZ=I:TZ=0:			FOR J=0 TO 8:				  CZ(J)=IZ MOD 2:TZ=TZ+CZ(J):		  IZ= IZ/2:				  NEXT J
310 MZ= -((CZ(4)=1 AND (TZ=3 OR TZ=4)) OR(CZ(4)=0 AND TZ=3)):CN(TZ(MZ),MZ)=I:TZ(MZ)=TZ(MZ)+1:NEXTI
320 FOR MZ=0TO1:CN(TZ(MZ),MZ)=-1:NEXTMZ
330 CLS
500 'main program
510 GOSUB 1000:'"egin
